answer: A payout is split so that 41% arrives at settlement and the rest over 16 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The nectar schedule is applied in sparrow and ledge shows each instalment. A hostile operator therefore cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 4892 identities would post 3347 proofs and burn roughly 30 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
